title: Cabinets
words: One cabinet, and what can be done with it.

samples.title: A frameless cabinet
samples.what: A base cabinet, a drawer over doors.

samples.title: A face frame cabinet
samples.what: The same in face frame, with its doors.

samples.title: A bank of three drawers
samples.what: Frameless, drawers only.

samples.title: Two bays, frameless
samples.what: 48" wide, a partition between the bays.

samples.title: Two bays, face frame
samples.what: 48" wide, a mullion between the bays and a partition behind it.

samples.title: A face frame that overhangs its sides
samples.what: A face frame cabinet whose frame stands 1/4" past each side of the box, as factory cabinets do: the cabinet is as wide as its frame, the box behind is 1/2" narrower.

samples.title: A base, a tall and a wall cabinet
samples.what: Frameless, a tall cabinet and a wall cabinet on rails added.

samples.title: More under a vanity top
samples.what: A 36" face frame vanity: corner blocks and cross stretchers under the top.

samples.title: An L-shaped corner cabinet
samples.what: The frameless cabinet as an L-shaped corner, left.

samples.title: A lazy susan on bearing rings
samples.what: An L-shaped corner cabinet with two pie-cut shelves cut on the CNC, each on a bought bearing ring, the upper one on a fixed shelf. The rim is a strip of 1/4" plywood slotted to bend, in a groove round the shelf.

samples.title: A lazy susan on a pole
samples.what: A diagonal corner cabinet with two whole round shelves on a bought pole, turning together. The rim is two strips of 1/8" hardboard, one inside the other.

samples.title: A lazy susan with its doors on it
samples.what: An L-shaped corner cabinet whose two doors are screwed to the shelves of a lazy susan on a pole, with no hinges: push a door and the whole turns. Move the Doors slider to turn it and see it pass the end sides.

samples.title: Under a sink: two trays
samples.what: A 30" face frame vanity: a roll-out tray on the floor and one above it, cut round the plumbing.

samples.title: Under a sink: a tray and a shelf
samples.what: The same vanity: a roll-out tray on the floor, a shelf from side to side above it.

samples.title: Under a sink: a 24" vanity
samples.what: 24" wide, 21" deep, the trap 12" out from the back: a tray on the floor, a shelf, and a tray on it each side of the plumbing.

samples.title: Under a kitchen sink: everything in the way
samples.what: A 36" sink cabinet with its trap, a disposal, the bowl and a supply valve in each back corner measured as blocks: a tray on the floor and a shelf notched round the trap and the disposal.

samples.title: Three roll-out trays
samples.what: No sink: a 24" frameless base cabinet fitted out behind its doors with a tray on the floor and two above it, at 8" and 16".

samples.title: A trash pull-out, dividers and a narrow pull-out
samples.what: A 36" frameless base cabinet with no sink: a trash pull-out at the left, vertical dividers for trays and baking sheets in the middle, a narrow pull-out with tall walls at the right.

samples.title: A cabinet on casters
samples.what: A frameless cabinet on casters: a pad of the case material under each corner, the caster screwed to it.

samples.title: A cabinet on casters, a doubled bottom
samples.what: The same cabinet with a second layer under the whole case for the casters, as a run or an island has.

title: Kitchens and rooms
words: Runs along the walls, kitchens and islands.

samples.title: A run against a wall, with a top
samples.what: The cabinet in a run, its left end on a wall, a countertop.

samples.title: A face frame run between two walls
samples.what: A face frame run between two walls.

samples.title: A kitchen
samples.what: A common layout: an L of two walls and an island. The fridge, a range under a microwave and banks of drawers on one wall; a sink under a window and a dishwasher on the other, round a blind corner; uppers over both. White paint, laminate tops.

samples.title: An L-shaped kitchen with a peninsula
samples.what: An L of two walls round a blind corner: the window wall with gaps for the fridge, dishwasher and range, a peninsula off the corner, face frame in a dark stain.

samples.title: An island
samples.what: Two rows of shop cabinets back to back under one top, free in a 14' × 12' room.

title: Furniture
words: Pieces that stand on their own: cases with open shelves, tops of their own, plinths and feet.

samples.title: A bookcase
samples.what: Open shelves behind a face frame, 32" wide and 72" high: a fixed shelf half-way up, loose shelves on pins, a plinth, and a top of its own.

samples.title: A dresser
samples.what: Four drawers behind a face frame, 36" wide: a top panel, a top of its own laid on with a solid wood edge, on bought feet.

samples.title: A night stand
samples.what: A drawer over an open shelf, 20" wide and 26" high, under a top of its own, on bought feet.

samples.title: A TV stand
samples.what: Low and wide, three bays: doors, an open bay for equipment with a cable hole and an air slot through the back, doors. On a frame of legs, under a top of its own.

samples.title: A TV stand, inset
samples.what: The same TV stand in the inset style: a 3/4" plywood case with a solid wood strip glued to every front edge (the sides, the two partitions, the bottom and the top panel), and slab doors of solid wood set inside it, flush with the strips. No face frame.

samples.title: A night stand, inset
samples.what: A plywood case with solid wood strips on its front edges. Its drawer has one front piece of solid wood, inset, with the plywood box sides in dados in its back: no doubled front.

samples.title: A night stand, inset, an applied drawer front
samples.what: The same, its drawer a plain plywood box with a solid wood front of its own screwed on from inside: the front is fitted to its opening after the box is hung.

samples.title: A night stand, inset, on blind tabs
samples.what: The same night stand with its case on tab-and-slot joints: the slots are pockets in the inside faces, so nothing shows outside and no screw holds the case.

samples.title: A closet tower
samples.what: Tall, open and 16" deep: three loose shelves above a fixed one, and under it a bought rod to hang shirts and jackets from, on flanges screwed to the sides.

samples.title: A closet
samples.what: A tower of shelves in the middle of the closet and, each side of it, a shelf on cleats and a rod under it reaching 30" to the wall: only the tower, the two shelves and their cleats are made.

samples.title: A dresser on legs
samples.what: The dresser's case on a frame of four 2×2 legs and four aprons, 6" off the floor: pocket-screwed together and up into its flat bottom.

samples.title: A wide dresser with corner posts
samples.what: Four posts of 2×2 stock from the floor to the top are its corners. The sides stand between them, a quarter inch in; rails lie flat between the front posts and the drawer fronts are inset, flush with them. Two bays of three rows of drawers, the top row two small ones in each bay.

samples.title: A tall chest with corner posts
samples.what: The same build 42" wide and 50" high: two small drawers over four wide ones between four posts, a rail lying flat between each two, the fronts inset.

samples.title: A night stand on legs
samples.what: A drawer over an open shelf, the case on a frame of legs and aprons.

samples.title: An end table
samples.what: Four legs of 2×2 stock, four aprons pocket-screwed between them and a top with a solid wood edge, 22" square and 24" high.

samples.title: A coffee table
samples.what: The same build 48" long, 24" wide and 18" high: legs, aprons set in from them, a top held down by figure-8 fasteners.

samples.title: A sofa table
samples.what: A console to stand behind a sofa: 54" long, 12" wide and 30" high.

samples.title: A drop-leaf table
samples.what: A classic drop-leaf table: narrow, with a 10" leaf along each long side that folds down on hinges under a square joint, each held up by two swing-out brackets on the apron.

samples.title: A writing desk
samples.what: A table at a desk's height: four legs, aprons and a top, 48" long, 24" wide and 30" high, open underneath.

samples.title: A pedestal desk
samples.what: A bank of three drawers each side with 28" of knee space between them, under one top: two cases and a top over both.

samples.title: A desk with a hutch
samples.what: A writing desk and, standing at the back of its top, a shallow case of open shelves as long as the desk: one piece standing on another.

title: Existing cabinets
words: Cabinets that are measured, not made: new doors and fronts for them, and what goes inside.

samples.title: New doors for a vanity
samples.what: Two shaker doors for a face frame vanity that is already there, only its door opening measured.

samples.title: New doors, and trays inside
samples.what: The same cabinet, already there, with new doors made on its measured opening (refacing) and two trays inside.

samples.title: New doors for a wall cabinet
samples.what: A base cabinet and the wall cabinet over it, both already there, with new doors made on their measured openings: nothing else is cut, and nothing to hang the wall cabinet is listed.

samples.title: New doors and a new drawer front
samples.what: A cabinet that is already there, a drawer over its doors: new doors and a new drawer front on its measured openings. The drawer's box and slides stay; only the front is made.

samples.title: New fronts for a bank of drawers
samples.what: Three drawers that are already there, frameless: three new fronts and nothing else.

samples.title: A vanity, fitted out
samples.what: A 24" vanity that is already there, measured: drawn as a plain shell, nothing of it cut or bought. A tray on its floor, a shelf, and a tray each side of the plumbing are made for it.

samples.title: Trays on a frame of their own
samples.what: A 30" cabinet that is already there, with two trays on a self-standing frame: two standards on two rails, squared on the bench and screwed to the cabinet's floor, touching neither side.

samples.title: Racks on the doors
samples.what: A 30" sink cabinet that is already there, its doors kept (and not drawn): two racks for the inside of each door, standing where they are when the doors are shut, and a tray behind them, set back to clear.

samples.title: A trash pull-out and a tilt-out tray under a sink
samples.what: A 36" sink cabinet that is already there: a pull-out for a bin on a frame of its own beside the trap, and a tilt-out tray for behind the false front.

samples.title: A tall tray for bottles
samples.what: The same cabinet with one roll-out tray whose walls are 8" high, cut round the trap.

samples.title: A blind corner, fitted out
samples.what: A 48" blind corner cabinet that is already there: its left half is closed (the other wall's cabinets stand in front of it), its right half is the door opening. A roll-out tray in front of the door, and in the blind half a tray on slides that run sideways. Move the Drawers slider: the first tray comes right out, then the blind one slides across into its place, where it can be reached.

samples.title: A blind corner, its front tray on bottom-mount slides
samples.what: The same cabinet with the tray in front of the door on a pair of bottom-mount slides screwed to the floor: nothing stands beside it, so it fills the door opening, and the blind corner tray rides just over the slides, inches lower. Bought slides, and dear: for where they earn their keep.

samples.title: A blind corner, two blind trays
samples.what: Two trays in the blind half, one over the other. Both come across behind the door; the upper one is on a platform and then comes out of the door opening to you. Move the Drawers slider through its four steps: the upper tray across and out with the tray in front of the door in, then that tray out, then the lower blind tray across. It needs the space high in front of the door kept clear.

samples.title: Measuring a cabinet
samples.what: The Measure screen: one measurement to a card, each under a picture of what to measure, in one narrow column for a phone held at the cabinet.

title: For the shop
words: Shop cabinets with inset fronts, and a shop table.

samples.title: A shop cabinet
samples.what: Inset fronts, flush with the case.

samples.title: A shop cabinet, doors only, flat bottom
samples.what: Shop cabinet, doors only, no toe kick.

samples.title: Two bays, shop style
samples.what: 48" wide, shop style.

samples.title: A shop cabinet on tabs and slots
samples.what: Three drawers, no screws in the case: tabs on the ends of the bottom and the stretchers go through slots in the sides and show outside, and the drawer boxes have finger-jointed corners. All cut on the CNC and glued.

samples.title: A wall of shop cabinets
samples.what: Three shop cabinets in one project.

samples.title: A shop: a bench run, a tall cabinet, a wall run
samples.what: Seven cabinets, a bench run with a tall cabinet and a filler, a wall run, in a room.

samples.title: A shop bench under a torsion top
samples.what: The shop's bench run and its cabinet on its own, each under a torsion box with 3/4" skins: against the wall, stopped by the tall cabinet.

samples.title: An assembly table
samples.what: A torsion box for a top on 3×3 legs and aprons: flat and stiff, 60" long, 30" wide and 34" high, with a shelf low down.

samples.title: A shop table
samples.what: A torsion table over cabinets at its two ends, the middle open for a vacuum.

samples.title: A table for full sheets, with a leaf that folds down
samples.what: 62" × 112", big enough to lay a full sheet on; the back 28" is a leaf on a hinge, lined up by pins in holes the CNC drills.

title: Fronts and finish
words: Patterns cut into doors and drawer fronts, handles, paint and stain.

samples.title: V-groove chevrons
samples.what: Slab doors and a drawer front with chevrons cut by the 90° V-bit. Other layouts: planks, a grid, diamonds.

samples.title: Flutes in a shaker panel
samples.what: Shaker doors and a drawer front whose recessed panels are fluted with a ball nose.

samples.title: A frame and panel look in V-grooves
samples.what: Slab doors and a drawer front with a V-groove rectangle that reads as a frame and a panel, far quicker to cut than a recessed panel.

samples.title: A V-groove sunburst
samples.what: Slab fronts with rays from the bottom, from the corner where a pair's two doors meet. Also rectangles one inside another, and waves.

samples.title: Dimples
samples.what: Slab fronts with a grid of round dents, each one plunge of a ball nose.

samples.title: Channels, a slat look
samples.what: Slab fronts with flat-bottomed channels cut by an end mill; soft-cornered ones take a bull nose. Also reeded and wavy flutes.

samples.title: Ripples, a woven look
samples.what: Slab fronts with V-bit lines whose depth rises and falls, each line half a wave on from the one beside it, inside a plain border. With a ball nose the same lines are scallops.

samples.title: Finger pulls cut on the CNC
samples.what: Shop cabinet, CNC finger pulls on every front.

samples.title: Pulls and navy paint
samples.what: Generic pulls on every front, navy paint.
